job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is an Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System RFP, not an OPERS RFP. Its proposal deadline is in 2025 and does not support the requested OPERS deadline.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (RFP) is issued by the Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System.
Proposals must be received by the Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System on or before 4:30 p.m. AKT, Friday, May 30, 2025.
